doc: world/request-ui.md is canonical for behavior + copy. This file is the machine-readable mirror: action catalog, rates, and feed vocabulary. Prices adopt rw-monetization-plan-2026-09-22 §2.2–2.3 (PROPOSAL — do not contradict in player-facing copy).

actions.label: Possess your character
actions.note: Mains (C1–C8) + landlord unpossessable — locked. Briefing = public profile + surface relationships + routine only.

actions.label: NPC nudge
actions.note: An ask, not mind-control — the character may decline.

actions.label: Event trigger
actions.note: Drama-manager-mediated; one per resource per 24 h.

actions.label: Character hire
actions.note: One-time per character, slot-capped per account (creation.json). Includes starter wardrobe + apartment hunt; housing costs game dollars. Denied applications never bill.

resource_board.doc: v18 — the claims matrix rendered legibly to players, before any money is spent

states.cool: post-exclusive cooldown, shows minutes left, never skippable
states.locked: exclusive running, shows holder + minutes left
states.queued: queue depth shown as a count, never a position auction

resource_board.on_free: queued requests activate in FCFS order; review happens on activation, not while waiting

possession_briefing.doc: design §7 whitelist — previewed in the request form before payment; identical card to what the session opens on
possession_briefing.secrets: absent_by_schema — the record carries no secret field; UI copy says 'not redacted: absent'
possession_briefing.merge_target: game-v5 gsPossessBrief / gsBriefingAudit — same whitelist, enforced once

session_controls.end_early: graceful handoff identical to cap expiry; feed logs 'player session ended'; unused minutes inside the cap are not refunded
session_controls.low_balance_warning: toast at ≤15 funded minutes or ≤15 min left, whichever first; one-click top-up
session_controls.brain_state_shown: possession only — 'suspended — AI resumes on release'

moderation_contract: world/moderation.json — reason codes attach to 'not approved' feed entries; display filter (redact/withhold/quarantine) is an owner decision at build time

wallet.doc: v32 — the wallet is a contract surface: pack ladder + first-purchase bonus + spend cap + rewarded ads + itemized ledger. Numbers adopt monetization-plan §2.1/§2.7 verbatim (PROPOSAL).

first_purchase_bonus.disclosed: flagged in the sheet before the first buy — 'first purchase +50%'

rewarded_ads.placement: opt-in from the wallet sheet only — never pre-roll, never mid-session, never inside the sim view

wallet.ledger: every debit and refund itemized — the feed shows public refunds; the wallet ledger shows everything private (charges, pack buys, ad earns, appeal re-charges)

appeals.doc: v32 — denied requests carry a private appeal path per moderation.json appeal_flow
appeals.rule: a different reviewer decides — the console shows orig_reviewer so the rule is checkable
appeals.feed_visibility: aggregate only — individual appeals are never spectacle; recaps may count them
appeals.on_reversal: denial lifted — the request re-enters human review at its original quote; the charge re-applies only on approval (the deny refund already landed)
appeals.on_uphold: denial stands — second review is final for that request

co_sponsor.doc: v32 — identical exclusive intents may co-sign the running override instead of queueing (game-v2 GS_WX_OVR.sponsors is the merge target)
co_sponsor.class: compatible — joins a live claim, never locks a new one; auto-runs on a passing screen
co_sponsor.pricing: same flat block price as the running request — you are buying the same world event, not a discount
co_sponsor.attribution: every sponsor is named on the feed line
co_sponsor.scope: declared intents only — weather overrides ship in v32; venue events can adopt the same rule later

approve_modified.doc: v46 — the player side of moderation.json approve-modified: the reviewer returns a trimmed request, the player accepts or declines
approve_modified.rule: duration/scope trimmed only, never expanded; unused credits auto-refund; ambiguity resolves against the player
approve_modified.decline: full refund — the trim is an offer, not a bill; declining costs nothing
approve_modified.accept: runs the trimmed terms at the re-quoted total; the upfront-charge difference refunds on accept
approve_modified.player_affordance: the offer card shows old → new terms and both prices before any choice

queue_hold.doc: v46 — the ≤24 h hold is visible on the queued card as a countdown, not just a promise
queue_hold.display: hold H h M min left of 24 h · expiry auto-refunds
queue_hold.expiry: auto-refund at zero — 'queued request expired before activation' on the feed (locked)
queue_hold.on_activation: review happens on activation; the hold clock stops the moment the slot is reached

scheduled_events.doc: v46 — approved flat exclusives (weather, event triggers, activated queued requests) fire on schedule and show it
scheduled_events.feed: 'running' when the event fires, 'resolved' when it ends — attribution (the filer's handle) stays on both lines
scheduled_events.trimmed: events running under modified terms say so on the fire line

live_seam.doc: v60 — the page is bridged when the game request bus is present (production-1's flag item)
live_seam.detect: window.__aiBridge with gsViewerState — badge reads 'live · __aiBridge', else 'mirror — local pipeline'

reads.gsViewerState(): .feed entries render onto the public feed (deduped by id; status → chip via the feed_vocabulary map); .sessions drive the resource board's locked states by claim key
reads.gsCoSessions(): optional — live sponsor lists for co-sponsorable claims (game-v2 GS_WX_OVR.sponsors)
reads.gsExplainRequest(id): optional — live request detail for the receipt drawer

live_seam.write: gsRequestSubmit({action, target, duration_min, text, queued, co_sponsor, quote_cr}) — capability-checked at file time; absent → the local pipeline runs as the contract reference; a refused call falls back the same way
live_seam.fallback: demo claims/feed stand in for resources the bus doesn't name; a poll hiccup keeps the last good frame

preflight_check.doc: v60 — 'check wording first — free' runs RWScreen.screenRequest on the current form before money moves
preflight_check.cost: free — screening never touches the wallet; credits move only on file
preflight_check.honesty: the preview verdict is the same one the pipeline would reach — shown early so a doomed request costs the player nothing, not even a refund wait
preflight_check.not_a_shadow_ban: a 'would not be approved' preview never blocks filing — the player may still file; deny then auto-refunds in full. The button informs, it does not gate

receipt.doc: v60 — every request card expands into a receipt: declared action/target/duration, intent text, upfront charge, claim key, and a timestamped status trail
receipt.trail: declared → screened → (queued | review | co-sponsor filed) → running → resolved/refunded; appeals, holds, modified terms all append — the private mirror of the public feed lines
receipt.ref: rq-<id> — stated on the receipt; the feed lines it mirrors carry the same request

demo_hooks.doc: v46 — merge points for the analytics spec (marketing analytics-events.json PENDING hooks); local-only in-page array window.RW_DEMO_EVENTS, nothing leaves the file

session_extend.doc: v32 — a running session may buy more minutes at its own rate while the class cap allows
session_extend.rates: session class rate — compatible 1.5 cr/min; camera 10 cr per +30 min
session_extend.cap: total session length never exceeds the class max (120 min compatible; camera uncapped but sold in +30 blocks)
session_extend.low_balance: insufficient balance disables the button and links the wallet sheet — the top-up to extend path is one click

fairness_invariants: hard cap — no overrun; forced graceful handoff at zero
no auctions for slots; FCFS within class
a time slot is not an upgrade — booking never reprices

booking.doc: v74 — the Book: scheduled exclusives. Spec world/bookings.md; machine mirror world/bookings.json; public calendar surface world/book.html; the When picker in request.html.

window_min.weather: the block you bought is the window (60/120/240)

booking.review: human review at filing — exclusives always get eyes; a booked request is already approved when its window arrives
booking.price: same flat block price — a time slot is not an upgrade; surge keys off the window's local hour, shown before payment
booking.cancel: full refund until the window starts — after that it is a live exclusive
booking.conflict: a booked window claims the resource for that span; overlapping asks queue FCFS — never auctioned
booking.cooldown: bookings never skip cooldowns — the picker never offers a slot that opens inside a cooldown tail

live_seam.reads: gsViewerState().calendar (optional) → picker avoidance set, deduped by claim+start
live_seam.write: gsRequestSubmit gains start_slot (minutes-from-now) when a window was picked
